events.title: Family Trivia Night
events.location: Banana Bender Pub – The Shed, Palmview
events.description: A free, family-friendly trivia night offering a fun, social atmosphere with kid-friendly questions and prizes. A chance to gather and engage in light-hearted intellectual competition, though tickets are currently exhausted.

events.title: The Ultimate Superstars of Country Tribute
events.location: Banana Bender Pub – The Shed, Palmview
events.description: An evening of live country music featuring a tribute band playing hits from Luke Combs, Morgan Wallen, and Chris Stapleton. Expect a lively atmosphere for fans of modern country.

events.title: Janice & The Violets (Live in the Beer Garden)
events.location: Banana Bender Pub Beer Garden, Palmview
events.description: Enjoy a relaxed Sunday afternoon with live soulful vocals and classic favourites from Janice & The Violets in the beer garden. A free, laid-back musical performance with a pleasant atmosphere.

events.title: Eumundi Markets (Wednesday)
events.description: Explore a vibrant market offering handcrafted wares, local produce, live music, arts, and global food. A recurring community event fostering local creativity and connection.

events.title: Eumundi Markets (Saturday)
events.description: The iconic Eumundi Markets features a diverse range of local arts, crafts, entertainment, and fresh produce. A bustling community hub with quirky stalls and street performers.

events.title: NightQuarter — Regular Weekend Markets (Friday)
events.description: An evening market and entertainment precinct with live music, immersive performances, market stalls, and global street food. A recurring event for a vibrant, creative community experience.

events.title: NightQuarter — Regular Weekend Markets (Saturday)
events.description: Experience NightQuarter's electric atmosphere with global street food, live music, carnival fun, and immersive performances around every corner. A great spot for a creative and social weekend outing.

events.title: NightQuarter — Party in the USA (Independence Day Themed Event)
events.description: A themed event celebrating Independence Day with Jukebox Heroes performing American artist hits and a patriotic fire twirling show. Embrace the red, white, and blue dress code for a festive, performance-driven night.

events.title: Nambour Town Square Market
events.description: Discover local organic food, crafts, and fresh produce at this weekly community market in Nambour. A great opportunity to support local artisans and connect with the community.

events.title: Norton Music Factory — Underground Metal Night (We the Hollow)
events.description: A night of crushing riffs and heavy music featuring We the Hollow, Burn the Kingdom, Oceans for Sirius, and RVNN. Experience the raw energy of the Sunshine Coast's underground metal scene.

events.title: Pomona Country Markets
events.description: A Saturday morning market offering local food, live music, and a diverse range of stalls to browse. A pleasant community gathering in the Noosa Hinterland.

events.title: Maleny Sunday Market
events.description: An undercover market featuring local arts, crafts, fresh produce, and community goods. A great place to explore local offerings rain or shine.
